evidence: Diagnostics identify a 1.59% unseen user rate in the validation split, and the diagnostic engine explicitly recommends investigating the 'cold_user_prior' experiment family.
expected_effect: Explicitly bucketing users by their training interaction counts will allow the model to learn robust activity-based priors, thereby improving ranking performance for cold and low-activity users.
hypothesis: Applying the user_activity_bucket operator during the features stage will help the model distinguish between highly active and cold/unseen users, resulting in better calibrated predictions and higher validation GAUC/nDCG.
